subject.title: fix(doctor): surface multi-account default routing warnings in preview and lint

question: Should missing explicit multi-account default routing become a default warning-level `openclaw doctor --lint` finding that returns a nonzero lint exit?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but default lint exit behavior is an operator compatibility decision for existing multi-account configs.

options.title: Accept warning-gated lint
options.body: Merge with the warning-level default lint check so affected multi-account configs fail lint until routing is made explicit.

options.title: Make lint non-failing
options.body: Keep preview and fix warnings but make this check opt-in, info-level, default-disabled, or otherwise non-failing for default lint compatibility.

options.title: Hold for broader diagnostics scope
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers scope the related missing-binding fallback diagnostics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97655 together.

recommendation.title: Accept warning-gated lint
recommendation.body: Merge with the warning-level default lint check so affected multi-account configs fail lint until routing is made explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work makes this the strongest routing candidate for doctor lint default behavior and structured health-check policy.
